objective: Reduce extreme concentration of economic power while preserving a real consumption floor and broad participation in capital returns.

mechanisms.design: Protect a defined real consumption bundle; nominal transfers adapt to prices and real capacity rather than a permanently fixed nominal amount.
Broad recurring allocation of K_C or equivalent social-capital claims.
A declared share of distributable system surplus may flow to broad beneficiaries subject to solvency and real-resource constraints.
Measure ultimate beneficial economic exposure rather than simple wallet balances; treat direct and synthetic exposure as analytically relevant.
Expand housing, energy, food, education, healthcare, infrastructure and productive capacity so redistributed purchasing power has real supply to purchase.

open_design_questions: relationship between K_C and enterprise governance
